title: The Chauffeur's Secret
synopsis: Arjun, heir to a glass-tower empire, takes a job as a chauffeur to test whether his fiancee Meera loves him or his money. Meera's family mocks him as a penniless servant and her father insults him in front of guests. Meera stands by him and quietly pays his fake debts from her own savings. On the day of the engagement party her father's firm is about to collapse, and the bank sends a mystery investor. Arjun walks in as the investor, reveals his real identity in front of everyone and saves the firm. Meera's father begs forgiveness while Meera decides whether she can trust a man who lied to her.

title: Night Shift Owner
synopsis: Billionaire Kabir Rao takes a job as the night janitor in his own tech company because money is disappearing from its accounts. He befriends Tanya, a lonely accountant who works late and slowly trusts him. Reading files after hours, he finds that the finance chief is siphoning funds into a shell company. The finance chief learns about the leak and frames Tanya for the theft. Kabir records the finance chief's confession on a hidden phone. At an emergency board meeting he reveals he is the owner, plays the recording and clears Tanya.

title: The Noodle Stall Husband
synopsis: Riya agrees to a paper marriage with Dev, a noodle stall cook, so that her dying grandfather can see her settled. Her mother-in-law and aunts humiliate Dev at every family dinner and tell Riya to divorce him. Dev quietly pays the family's overdue rent. When the landlord threatens to evict the whole family, it turns out Dev secretly owns the building. At a family dinner he tears up the eviction notice and announces that he is the landlord. Riya realises the paper marriage has become real, and her mother-in-law has to apologise to a noodle cook.

title: Delivery Boy, Dining Empire
synopsis: Vikram, owner of a restaurant chain, delivers food on a scooter for a week to see how his customers live. He falls for Pooja, a waitress at a small family cafe that is failing. A rival tycoon tries to buy the cafe and shut it down for its land. Vikram secretly buys the tycoon's debt, forcing the tycoon to withdraw. Pooja finds the paperwork and suspects Vikram has been spying on her. After an angry argument he confesses who he is, and she walks away. He reopens the cafe in her name.

title: The Intern Who Owns the Floor
synopsis: Heiress Naina joins her father's design company as an unpaid intern using her mother's maiden name. Her manager Sunil takes credit for her sketches and publicly calls her useless. Naina keeps a dated sketchbook as proof while she watches him pitch her designs. At the product launch Sunil unveils her collection as his own. Naina shows the sketchbook on the big screen and announces that she is the owner's daughter. Sunil is escorted out and the company changes its credit policy.

title: Ashes at the Altar
synopsis: Ananya is left at the altar when her groom Rohan runs away with her younger sister Kavya. In front of the shocked guests she proposes to Rohan's powerful uncle Mr. Malhotra, who accepts. She moves into the Malhotra house, where Rohan and Kavya must now call her aunt. Ananya gathers proof that Kavya and Rohan stole from her late mother's trust fund. At the family anniversary she plays the evidence on the dining room screen. Rohan and Kavya are thrown out, and Ananya learns why the uncle really said yes.

title: Divorce Papers, Diamond Return
synopsis: Sana is divorced by her husband Aditya, who is having an affair with his assistant, and is thrown out of the house with nothing. She secretly is the anonymous jewellery designer whose collections made his company famous. Sana builds a rival brand under a new name and starts winning his clients. Aditya's company slides toward bankruptcy, and he discovers who is behind the new brand. He shows up at her studio begging to remarry. Sana signs one paper only: the sale of his failing company to her.

title: Reborn Before the Fire
synopsis: Leena is killed in a house fire set by her husband Nikhil and her best friend Ishita, who want her inheritance. She wakes up three years in the past on the day of her engagement. Remembering everything, she quietly changes her will and records the couple plotting. She avoids the engagement and takes the fire's date to move her family out of the house. When the fire is set again, it burns an empty house and the police trace the arson to Nikhil. Ishita confesses to save herself, and Leena finally lives the life she was denied.

title: The Framed Surgeon
synopsis: Dr. Meghna is blamed for the death of a patient during surgery and loses her licence. The real culprit is her rival Dr. Bhatt, who swapped the medication label. Meghna takes a job as a night nurse in a rural clinic under another name. A dying clinic patient hands her an old hospital laptop that holds the operating-room recording. She sends the recording to the medical council during a live conference. Dr. Bhatt is arrested and Meghna is invited back.

title: Swapped at Birth
synopsis: Tara, a girl raised in a slum, learns through a DNA test that she was swapped at birth with the daughter of a rich family. The rich family brings her home but treats her as an embarrassment and keeps favouring the girl they raised, Simran. Simran secretly knew the truth for years and hid the test results. Tara finds the hospital file proving Simran's mother paid the nurse to swap the babies. At the family's charity gala she reveals the file. The rich mother must publicly admit she chose the wrong child.

title: Twins He Never Knew
synopsis: Pregnant Isha leaves the city after CEO Armaan's mother pays her to disappear. She raises twin boys alone in a small town. Five years later Armaan meets the twins by accident at a school sports day and notices they look just like him. He demands a paternity test and fights for custody. Isha reveals that his mother bribed her to leave. Armaan confronts his mother, and the boys ask their parents to come to the school play together.

title: The Maid Who Was His Wife
synopsis: After a car crash, Zoya wakes up with no memory. Her husband's mistress Diya convinces her that she is only the household maid and makes her scrub floors. Zoya finds a hidden diary under a loose floorboard that tells her real story. She slowly recovers her memory but pretends to still be confused. At the husband's charity gala she walks in as the lady of the house and plays the mistress's recorded lies. The husband realises how he was deceived, and Diya is removed.

title: The Widow's Ledger
synopsis: Widow Lakshmi discovers that her husband faked his death to escape his debts and left her with the loan sharks. She works at a tailoring shop and secretly buys up his creditors' notes one by one. She tracks him to a luxury hotel in another city living under a new name. In the hotel lobby she serves him with papers showing that she now owns every debt he ran from. He signs over his hidden accounts to avoid prison.

title: Rejected by the Alpha
synopsis: At the full moon ceremony, Alpha Kael publicly rejects his fated mate Luna, calling her weak because she cannot shift. Luna is banished from the pack and wanders into the mountains. A dying old wolf tells her she is the last descendant of the Moon Goddess, and her power is waking. Rogue wolves attack Kael's pack and he cannot stop them. Luna returns, shifts into a white wolf and defeats the rogues. Kael begs her to accept him again and she decides to say no.

title: Blood Contract
synopsis: To save her sick brother, Lena signs a blood contract to serve vampire prince Dorian for one year. In his castle she learns that the court plans to kill the prince before the coronation. Lena befriends Dorian and he starts to trust her. She discovers that the poison is being delivered through the royal wine by the prince's own steward. She switches the goblets at the coronation banquet. The steward drinks the poison, and Dorian offers to tear up the contract.

title: Villainess Transmigrated
synopsis: Modern office worker Mira falls asleep over a web novel and wakes up inside it as the villainess who is executed in chapter thirty. She knows every plot point and tries to avoid each trap. She befriends the cold duke who in the novel kills her. The novel's heroine turns out to be another transmigrator who wants the duke for herself. In the final trial Mira uses her knowledge of the novel to expose the heroine's fake visions. The duke chooses Mira and the story breaks away from its script.

title: The Mafia Boss's Nanny
synopsis: Nina takes a job as nanny to the five-year-old daughter of mafia boss Viktor Rossi. She is secretly looking for the man who killed her brother. At the boss's villa she finds a photo that proves the killer was Viktor's brother Marco, not Viktor. Viktor catches her searching his office and demands the truth. She confesses, and Viktor reveals he has also been hunting Marco. Together they set a trap at the daughter's birthday party and Marco is arrested.

title: Undercover Bride
synopsis: Detective Rhea goes undercover and marries crime boss Armand Cole to collect evidence for her department. Living in his mansion she begins to see that he protects his workers and fights a corrupt commissioner. She falls for him despite her mission. Her handler orders her to arrest Armand on their anniversary. Rhea discovers the handler is the commissioner's informant who has been selling every secret. She exposes the handler on a live broadcast and has to choose between her badge and Armand.

title: The Mother-in-Law Test
synopsis: Daughter-in-law Aarti is treated like a servant by her mother-in-law Savitri, who criticises every dish and every task. Aarti endures it quietly for her husband's sake. A family lawyer reveals that Savitri has been running a secret test to find out who is worthy to inherit the family temple trust. At the reading of the will, Savitri names Aarti the trustee because she alone never complained or cheated. Aarti's sisters-in-law are furious. Savitri finally hugs her.

title: The Stolen Recipe
synopsis: Chef Mallika's sous-chef Dhruv steals her secret biryani recipe and wins a televised cooking contest with it. Mallika is fired from the restaurant and starts selling biryani from a street cart. A food vlogger films her cart, and the video goes viral overnight. Dhruv's restaurant cannot reproduce the recipe's key ingredient. Mallika challenges Dhruv to a live cook-off in front of a studio audience. She wins and opens her own restaurant.

title: Kidney for a Contract
synopsis: Karan needs money for his mother's kidney transplant and signs a contract to work as bodyguard to heiress Samaira. Samaira treats him coldly and tests his loyalty with dangerous tasks. At the hospital they learn that Samaira's blood matches his mother's. Samaira secretly agrees to donate a kidney and swears the doctors to silence. Karan finds out on the day of the operation and storms into the operating theatre. His mother survives, and Samaira finally admits she needs a bodyguard for her heart.

title: The Reunion Investor
synopsis: Ishaan was bullied at school by classmate Rahul and left the town in shame. Ten years later he returns for the class reunion as the star investor of a billion-dollar fund. Rahul, now a struggling shopkeeper, mocks him before learning who he is. Ishaan offers Rahul's whole street a place in a new mall development. Rahul begs for a place in it. Ishaan gives him a job as security guard and walks away without a word.

title: Fake Girlfriend, Real Problem
synopsis: Employee Pari is hired by her boss Neil to pretend to be his girlfriend at his sister's wedding. His grandmother grows fond of Pari and invites her to every family event. Neil's ex-fiancee shows up and tries to expose the deal. The contract is extended for another month. On a rooftop, Neil confesses that he stopped pretending long ago. Pari tears up the contract and kisses him.

title: The Street Singer's Voice
synopsis: Orphan singer Ria performs on busy streets, and a viral video reaches the wealthy Kapoor family. Mrs. Kapoor sees a birthmark and believes Ria is her long-lost daughter. A DNA test confirms it. Ria is welcomed home, but her stepbrother schemes to push her out before the inheritance is divided. He forges evidence that she is a fraud. At the Kapoor annual concert Ria sings her mother's lullaby and the cousin who stole the baby confesses.

title: Twin in the Wedding Dress
synopsis: Twin sister Hina is begged to take her runaway sister Heer's place at a wedding to billionaire Zayn. She wears the dress and keeps up the act in the groom's mansion. Hina finds out that Heer ran away to escape a debt to a gangster. Zayn becomes suspicious when Hina behaves unlike the girl he met. He confronts her in the garden and she confesses everything. Zayn pays the gangster, then asks to marry Hina for real.

title: Kidnapped on the Mandap
synopsis: Bride Anjali is abducted from her own wedding by masked men. The groom Veer refuses to pay the ransom, which turns her family against him. Anjali escapes and discovers the kidnapper was hired by her stepmother. She records the stepmother's call to the kidnapper and brings it to the police. The stepmother is arrested at the reception. Veer reveals that he refused to pay because he had already tracked the kidnappers.

title: The Same Wedding Day
synopsis: Wedding planner Tanvi relives the same wedding day every morning after a lightning strike. Each loop she finds a different disaster: a missing ring, a food poisoning, a runaway groom. She slowly realises one guest is sabotaging every loop. She traps the saboteur, the bride's ex, with a fake gift. The loop breaks only when she lets the wedding go ahead with its imperfections. She wakes up on the day after.

title: Last Round
synopsis: Disgraced former boxing champion Ravi is banned after a match-fixing scandal. He starts training Gudiya, an orphan girl from his neighbourhood. A rival gym owner tries to buy Gudiya's contract and threatens Ravi. Ravi proves in public that the match-fixing was ordered by that same owner. Gudiya fights in the state final, takes a heavy hit in round three and gets up. She wins on points as Ravi cries in her corner.

title: The Scholarship Girl
synopsis: Scholarship student Rani is mocked by rich classmates for her cheap uniform and village accent. She wins the national maths olympiad. The prize ceremony is hosted by Mr. Sethi, the father of her biggest tormentor. Rani recognises a formula on his company's patent as her late father's work. She finds her father's notebook and takes it to a lawyer. Mr. Sethi is forced to share ownership of the patent with Rani.

title: The Last Will Game
synopsis: A dying tycoon announces a contest among his three grandchildren to inherit his empire. Two rich grandchildren spend the month fighting each other and bribing the lawyer. The poorest grandchild, Isha, simply visits the old man every evening and reads to him. A hidden clause in the will says the heir must be the one who stayed. The tycoon dies and the lawyer reads the clause. Isha inherits everything, and she gives the cousins a salary.
